experiences.name: Sagrada Família Guided Tour
experiences.description: Explore Gaudí's iconic unfinished basilica with a skip-the-line guided tour. Marvel at the intricate facades, stunning stained glass windows, and learn about the architectural genius behind this UNESCO World Heritage Site. Tower access offers panoramic city views.

experiences.name: Gothic Quarter Walking Tour
experiences.description: Wander through Barcelona's medieval heart, discovering Roman ruins, Gothic cathedrals, and hidden plazas. A self-guided or group tour reveals 2,000 years of layered architecture from ancient Roman walls to medieval palaces and modernist touches.

experiences.name: Park Güell & Gràcia Neighborhood Exploration
experiences.description: Visit Gaudí's whimsical mosaic-covered park with its iconic dragon staircase and panoramic terraces, then descend into the bohemian Gràcia neighborhood to explore its charming squares, independent boutiques, and vibrant café culture.

experiences.name: Tapas Crawl & Vermouth Hour in El Born
experiences.description: Experience Barcelona's legendary food culture with a self-guided tapas crawl through El Born's atmospheric bars. Sample patatas bravas, pan con tomate, jamón ibérico, and fresh seafood pintxos while enjoying local vermut (vermouth) at traditional bodegas.
experiences.location: El Born, Sant Pere district, Barcelona

experiences.name: Barceloneta Beach Sunset & Nightlife on Passeig Marítim
experiences.description: Relax on Barcelona's most famous urban beach at golden hour, then transition into the city's legendary nightlife along the seafront promenade. Enjoy cocktails at beach clubs like Opium or Pacha, which don't hit their stride until midnight, offering world-class DJs and a vibrant international crowd.
